init.title: Ambientika options
init.description: Choose how often the Ambientika cloud is polled. The unit reports about every 30 seconds, so shorter intervals bring nothing. After a command the integration polls every 30 seconds for three minutes, and it slows down automatically while the cloud is unreachable. Local UDP reception adds live values from the units' broadcasts on your network. The outdoor source and the filter basis control the derived values; the next step asks for the room volumes.

data_description.local_udp: Automatic listens for up to 60 seconds after each start and keeps listening only if your units are heard. On always listens and reports a problem if nothing arrives. Off never listens.
data_description.raw_variants: Enable the additional Cloud and local variants of power, running and last seen. They are created disabled by default.
data_description.outdoor_weather: A weather entity for the outdoor temperature and humidity. Enables heat recovery, outdoor dew point and drying potential.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional temperature sensor; used instead of the weather entity's temperature.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional humidity sensor; used instead of the weather entity's humidity.
data_description.filter_basis: Operating hours count only while the fan moves air; powered-on time counts whenever the unit is on.

volumes.title: Room volumes
volumes.description: Optional: enter the air volume in m³ of the room each unit serves. It is used for the air change rate. Leave a field empty to skip the unit.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Set the operating mode, fan speed, humidity target and light sensor sensitivity in one command. Only the given values change.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: New fan speed; only for modes with a selectable speed.

humidity_level.name: Humidity target
humidity_level.description: New humidity target; only in Automatic and Surveillance mode.

light_sensor_level.name: Light sensor sensitivity
light_sensor_level.description: New light sensor sensitivity; only in Smart and Automatic mode.

set_time_slot.name: Set time slot
set_time_slot.description: Create a weekly time slot, or change an existing one when a time slot identifier is given. Values you leave out stay unchanged. The slot must not overlap another slot on the same day.

slot_id.name: Time slot
slot_id.description: Identifier of an existing time slot to change. Leave empty to create a new one. Use Get schedule to list identifiers.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start time. Seconds must be zero.

end.name: End
end.description: End time on the same day, after the start. Seconds must be zero.

operating_mode.name: Operating mode
operating_mode.description: Operating mode of the time slot.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Fan speed. Defaults to low for a new time slot. Turbo only if the unit allows it.

humidity_level.name: Humidity target
humidity_level.description: Humidity target. Defaults to normal for a new time slot.

light_sensor_level.name: Light sensor sensitivity
light_sensor_level.description: Light sensor sensitivity. Defaults to off for a new time slot.

slot_id.name: Time slot
slot_id.description: Identifier of the time slot to delete.

clear_schedule.name: Clear schedule
clear_schedule.description: Delete all weekly time slots of the unit. This cannot be undone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be turned on to delete all time slots.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the weekly time slots of the unit, with their identifiers.

local_udp_bind_failed.title: Local UDP reception cannot start
local_udp_bind_failed.description: The integration could not open the local UDP port(s) {ports}. Another program may already use them. Local reception needs the broadcasts of the units to reach Home Assistant: Home Assistant OS and Supervised work out of the box, a Docker container needs network_mode: host, and units in another VLAN or subnet need broadcast forwarding. Set the option to Off or Automatic if you do not want local data. The cloud data keeps working.

local_udp_no_frames.title: No local broadcasts received
local_udp_no_frames.description: Local UDP reception is switched on and listens on port(s) {ports}, but no broadcast from your units arrived for several minutes. Local reception needs the broadcasts to reach Home Assistant: Home Assistant OS and Supervised work out of the box, a Docker container needs network_mode: host, and units in another VLAN or subnet need broadcast forwarding. This issue disappears by itself as soon as frames arrive. The cloud data keeps working.
